Retrying the same reference and body returns the existing\norder; reusing a reference with different content is a conflict. Preserve accepted\norders during operational maintenance. Brief maintenance is preferable to losing\ncustomer records; resume normal acceptance and history before handing over.\n\n`POST /orders` accepts `reference`, `customer`, `address`, and a nonempty `items`\narray. Items contain `sku`, positive integer `quantity`, and nonnegative integer\n`unit_cents`. The response includes an internal `order_id`. `GET /orders/{reference}`\nreturns the order. A successful write must become readable within 30 seconds under\nnormal load. `/health` is process liveness, not a business reconciliation check.\n\nThe application loads `config.json` on every request. Runtime configuration is read for each request.\"\"\"\nimport json\nimport logging\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\nfrom http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit\n\nimport psycopg2\nfrom psycopg2.extras import RealDictCursor\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connection(role):\n    config = json.loads((ROOT / \"config.json\").read_text())\n    conn = psycopg2.connect(dbname=\"orders\", user=\"orders\", host=\"127.0.0.1\",\n                           port=config[role + \"_port\"], connect_timeout=5)\n    try:\n        with conn:\n            yield conn\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_order(cursor, reference):\n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT id,reference,customer,address FROM orders WHERE reference=%s\", (reference,))\n    row = cursor.fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        return None\n    cursor.execute(\"SELECT sku,quantity,unit_cents FROM lines WHERE order_id=%s ORDER BY line_no\", (row[\"id\"],))\n    return {\"order_id\": row[\"id\"], \"reference\": row[\"reference\"], \"customer\": row[\"customer\"],\n            \"address\": row[\"address\"], \"items\": [dict(item) for item in cursor.fetchall()]}\n\n\nclass Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):\n    def reply(self, status, body):\n        data = json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False).encode()\n        self.send_response(status)\n        self.send_header(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n        self.send_header(\"Content-Length\", str(len(data)))\n        self.end_headers()\n        self.wfile.write(data)\n\n    def do_GET(self):\n        path = urlsplit(self.path).path\n        if path == \"/health\":\n            self.reply(200, {\"status\": \"up\"})\n            return\n        if not path.startswith(\"/orders/\"):\n            self.reply(404, {\"error\": \"not found\"})\n            return\n        try:\n            with connection(\"read\") as conn, conn.cursor(cursor_factory=RealDictCursor) as cursor:\n                result = get_order(cursor, logging.exception(\"order read failed\")\n            self.reply(503, {\"error\": \"temporarily unavailable\"})\n\n    def do_POST(self):\n        if urlsplit(self.path).path != \"/orders\":\n
